HOW IT WORKS

How to number
PDF pages.

01

Open your PDF.

Choose a file from your device. It opens right here in your browser.

02

Choose the format.

Use {page} and {total}, for example Page {page} of {total}, then pick the starting number and position.

03

Download.

Numbers update as you work and follow the final page order, even if you rearrange pages afterwards.

GOOD TO KNOW

Questions, answered.

Can I start from a number other than 1?

Yes. Set any starting number, for example 5 for a document that continues an earlier one.

Where can the numbers go?

At the bottom left, centre or right of the page, with your choice of size, colour and margin.

Can I number several PDFs at once?

Yes. Batch & presets numbers each file separately, starting again for every PDF.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No. Numbering happens in your browser and the file never leaves your device.
